name: Shake Bar & Lounge
notes: 2 photos of the same printed menu, both legible, merged. The two printings disagree on some prices (Chicken Wings $18 vs $16, Blonde Ale-Battered Fish & Chips $22 vs $20, Wagyu Burger $24 vs $22) and Los Tacos swapped Baja Fish Taco for Blackened Shrimp between printings; used photo 2 (the newer-looking, asterisk-annotated printing) as the price source and kept both taco items since they don't overlap. Photo 2 also shows a Sweets section not fully visible in photo 1; Toffee Butter Cake's description has a shadow-obscured word so it is omitted rather than guessed.
